description: Race's own events, which clients send: exactly one of these. The host adds its built-in gps and wake.

line_stbd.description: set the starboard end where the boat is

line_port.description: set the port end where the boat is

bump_seq.description: not counting down: the gun `seconds` from the tap. Counting down: > 0 moves the gun earlier, < 0 later, 0 rounds the time left (from the tap) down to a whole minute

tapped_at.description: when the tap happened, on the device clock

race_finish.description: finish the race, or abort the countdown
